title: Discharge Summary Generation Is Not Just Summarization: A Reality Check for Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.14823v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Discharge summaries combine a retrospective account of hospitalization with discharge-time decisions. Physician-written references therefore contain both facts supported by prior clinical notes and reference-only content, potentially reflecting clinical synthesis, handoffs, or discharge planning. Reference-only evaluation can conflate failure to recover available information with failure to reproduce content absent from the model input.   We introduce FairSumEval, an evidence-aware, fact-level framework that assesses whether each reference and generated fact is supported by the model's evidence and captured by the other summary. The resulting outcome map separates matches, omissions, and additions. Two complementary metrics, Soft IoU-S and Soft IoU-NS, measure reference-generation agreement for facts with and without identified evidence support. translated_title: 出院小结生成不仅仅是摘要任务：对评估方法的一次现实检验
translated_abstract: 出院小结同时包含对住院过程的回顾性描述与出院时的临床决策。因此，医生撰写的参考文本中既包含有既往临床记录支持的事实，也包含仅存在于参考文本中的内容，后者可能反映了临床综合判断、交接班信息或出院规划。仅以参考文本为依据的评估方法，会将“未能从输入中恢复已有信息”与“未能再现输入中不存在的内容”这两种不同的失败混为一谈。我们提出了FairSumEval，一个证据感知、事实级别的评估框架，用于评估每个参考事实和生成事实是否得到模型可用证据的支持，以及是否被另一份摘要所涵盖。由此产生的结果映射可以区分匹配、遗漏和新增三类情况。两个互补指标Soft IoU-S和Soft IoU-NS分别衡量有证据支持与无证据支持事实的参考-生成一致性。在200例MIMIC-III住院记录上，18.8%的医生参考事实具有已识别的证据支持……
tldr: 提出证据感知的事实级评估框架FairSumEval，通过区分有证据支持与无证据支持的事实，纠正了将出院小结生成简单当作摘要任务来评估的偏差，实现更公平的评估。
en_tdlr: FairSumEval, an evidence-aware, fact-level evaluation framework that separates facts with and without evidence support, providing a reality check that discharge summary generation is not just summarization and enabling fairer evaluation.
